services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Navy Memorial is located in the heart of downtown Washington, DC, and accommodates a wide range of events, from corporate meetings and catered dinners to holiday parties and the latest Hollywood premiere. Learn more about how we can help you host a significant, memorable event in our nation’s capital. The Arleigh & Roberta Burke Theatre - The Burke Theatre at the Navy Memorial is a multi-use theatre boasting an updated LED wall, standing at 17 feet tall and 34.5 feet wide. It is the first of its kind in Washington, D.C., and is made up of 880 cells that each have 10,368 pixels, for a total of 9,123,840 pixels across the whole screen guaranteeing exceptionally clean viewing. blurb: The United States Navy Memorial Visitor Center tells the story of the American Sailor -- past, present, and future -- and honors, recognizes, and celebrates the men and women of the Sea Services. Through engaging exhibits, interactive displays, storytelling, and creative visuals, the Visitor Center inspires and informs thousands of visitors each year of the rich history and heritage of the United States Navy.
